prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

It is fused to her own living skin and flexes slightly over every bulge, with no fabric, seam or garment anywhere. It covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Broad powerful shoulders, a wide heavy chest, a large round soft belly hanging over a thick waist, thick strong arms, and wide heavy thighs beneath. Every curve is large, solid and continuous, with a warm, imposing bearing. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His body carries overlapping mother-of-pearl nacre tiles set edge to edge over his skin, each tile with a fine edge and a soft milky lustre that shifts through rainbow colours across every curve, BLAZING milky pearl-white nacre with pink and aqua lustre, VIVID soft rainbow sheen sliding across each tile.
